messages:
Olivia: sec-monitor flagged: found a live service API token in a public Figma comment on partner file. I removed the comment and redacted the link. Token prefix: rwd_live_abc...
Sam: Can you paste the token id prefix (last 6)?
Olivia: prefix ends with ...7c9f2. Not full value, redacted.
sec-bot: automated-scan: detected credential in third-party comment: file=PartnerA Onboarding, risk=high, detected_at=2334509876
Mina: That's the legacy mobile SDK ingest token (mobile-sdk-ingest-prod). It's embedded in older debug builds. Likely used for telemetry only.
Raj: Action items: 1) rotate the token immediately 2) revoke old token 3) enable extra audit logging for that token id 4) check usage in last 7 days for suspicious IPs
Olivia: I'm on revocation. Do we have a revoke API? Anyone? 
Mina: Yes: run:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/keys/revoke" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{\"key_id\":\"rwd_live_***7c9f2\"}'
```
I've redacted the full id.
Sam: I'm running the revoke now, will follow up with result.
sec-bot: revoke job started by Sam at 2334509923
Sam: revoke completed. response: {\"status\":\"ok\",\"revoked\":true}
Mina: I'll push a patch to mobile SDK to swap the hardcoded token for a short-lived JWT flow (KMS-signed) and cut a hotfix release.
Raj: Also: add RBAC change so that SDK tokens cannot mint other tokens and restrict to ingest scopes only.
Jen: Legal: if any customer data flowed through this token before revocation, we need to notify affected customers. Mina, can you confirm whether telemetry includes identifiable customer IDs?
Mina: Telemetry schema currently strips unique emails but includes hashed user_id and device_id. I'll run a dataflow query to enumerate any IDs and whether they map to customers.
Olivia: I started a fast forensic query on audit-logs: looking for activity with that key id in the last 72h.
sec-bot: audit-query queued. Expect ~5 min.
Sam: Also requested partner to delete the Figma comment and confirm removal. Partner says they removed it.
Raj: Longer-term: integrate Figma comment scanning into our external-scan pipeline and add required SSO for partners uploading files. Also consider blocking public comments with tokens.
Mina: For KMS integration, proposal: no long-lived SDK tokens. Instead sign ephemeral tokens with internal KMS (HSM) via short ttl (5m) and rotate root credentials daily.
Olivia: Post-incident actions assigned: Mina -> SDK hotfix & dataflow checks; Raj -> RBAC + audit retention config; Sam -> forensic logs & verify revocation; Jen -> comms + legal prep; Olivia -> incident writeup and SEV ticket.
Sam: ETA for rotation+verify: 30m. I'll update thread when done.
Olivia: Thanks all. Will open a postmortem template once we have final scope. :thumbsup:
